if(ICET_FOUND)
    # We need to link with OpenGL on Mac when we have IceT.
    if(APPLE)
        set(ICET_OPENGL ${OPENGL_gl_LIBRARY})
    endif()
    # Link icet libraries using absolute pathes
    set(ICET_FULLPATH_LIB ${ICET_OPENGL})
    foreach(X ${ICET_LIB})
        list(APPEND ICET_FULLPATH_LIB "${ICET_LIBRARY_DIR}/${X}")
    endforeach()
endif()



set(Volume_DEFINES)
if(VISIT_SLIVR)
    list(APPEND Volume_DEFINES VISIT_SLIVR)
endif()
if(ICET_FOUND)
    list(APPEND Volume_DEFINES HAVE_ICET)
endif()

if(ICET_FOUND)
    set(Volume_ELibs  ${ICET_FULLPATH_LIB})
endif()
